text.content:
Commorragh is no true Crystal Sphere but a hidden city in the Warp, a sinister mirror of Sigil ruled by the @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceDarkEldar]{Dark Eldarin} under @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.deities.Item.dtdDb4b4672a0d21]{Lolth}, the daemon spider queen who shields them from the Warp. It is built into the Webway, a hidden web of passages that, like the Umbra, lies between reality and the Warp; its strands may be woven from the souls of Lolth's sacrifices, though some orderly sections suggest a second weaver. Ships reach the city without leaving the Warp, so it is nearly impossible to trace, and supposedly only Dark @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceEldarin00]{Eldarin} can sense the way there.

Inside, the city feels like an endless cavern: drained of colour, damp and foggy, never quite the right temperature, dimly lit apart from garish neon at street level. The megastructure spans billions of kilometres, growing and shifting at Lolth's whim, far larger even than Dis. Its half-reality dulls light, thickens liquids and mutes emotions, which helps restrain the Dark Eldarin, though some argue their wild outbursts elsewhere are a reaction to it.

The decadent, cruel @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceDarkEldar]{Dark Eldarin} rule the city. Slaves of every description outnumber them but have been crushed by torment and terror. Lolth's daemonic servants roam the streets, playing with the Dark @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceEldarin00]{Eldarin} as those masters play with their victims. Nearly any person or creature might turn up here, particularly if some Dark Eldarin mistress finds its presence entertaining.

The Daemonweb Pits near the city's heart are Lolth's domain, a tangle of webs tens of thousands of kilometres across, where she schemes from a spider-shaped palace of darksteel and mithril with short-lived favourites; whispers that she is a fallen pattern spider are deadly to repeat. The city is divided among Kabals, paramilitary self-ruling powers born from noble houses and pleasure cults. Erelhei-Cinlu, fresh from civil war, now trades with outsiders bound by blood oaths, and many of them actually return alive.

Menzoberranzan is an ancient matriarchal Kabal of countless slaves, where rank is won by murder and torture and visitors become pawns in its deadly politics. Lying deep in the megastructure, it is often besieged from the Underdark. Its ruler, Triel Baenre, a feared priestess of @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.deities.Item.dtdDb4b4672a0d21]{Lolth}, quietly makes enemies disappear. The Underdark itself is an immense, lightless maze of steel and mist holding unseen seas, fungus forests, mutated ecologies, cannibal monsters, undead and rumoured lost treasure.

Story Master only: adventure seeds for this sphere.

An entire Crystal Sphere's population vanished in one day, apparently seized by the @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceDarkEldar]{Dark Eldarin}; the heroes must find a guide to the Dark City and learn why before the captives meet their fate. A rich merchant meeting Commorraghan contacts about becoming their trade front hires bodyguards in case of treachery, and they must take care not to offend their hosts. After a slave uprising in Erelhei-Cinlu, the Dark @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceEldarin00]{Eldarin} have offered a huge bounty for its hidden organizer, and the heroes may join the hunt or protect the rebel leader.
